purpose: The ONE conformance vector list both suites assert against (docs/EDITION-2-PLAN.md WS1 deliverable #3: 'the competitor POLICY has one source of truth ... plus ONE conformance-vector JSON file that both the Python and the TS test suites assert against'). Ranking may differ between the engine-api path and the web app's fallback path; this file is what proves the EXCLUSION POLICY never does. Both suites build their `relations` input from THIS DIRECTORY's `type_relations.json` (the same seed data every city database is migrated/seeded from) -- this file supplies only the (subject_type, candidate_type) pairs and the expected verdict, never a second copy of the matrix itself.

vectors.note: candidate_type is always an L1 type in practice -- 'villa' as a literal string has no relation row and is not excluded by this function; subtype-to-L1 resolution happens before this policy is consulted, see hard.py which reads primary_type (L1) directly
